C18. The vehicle got stuck at a construction site.
C19. Deputies detained the driver.
C20. The driver appeared to be under the influence.
C21. The driver resisted and kicked a deputy while being escorted into the back of a patrol vehicle.
C22. When asked about the crash, the driver responded "What crash?"
C23. The driver asked deputies to release him in exchange for $2,000.
C24. The driver walked to the patrol car calmly and without resisting.
C25. The driver said he was late for a job interview.
C26. When found, the dog's body was covered in sores and he was weak.

C28. The owner was arrested.
C29. The owner denied the neglect.
C30. The owner asked for his mom.
C31. A pipe was found in the owner's pocket.
C32. The owner thanked the detectives for taking care of the dog.

C34. A motorcycle fled from deputies during a traffic operation.
C35. The motorcycle sped at high speed, weaving in and out of traffic.
C36. The aviation unit was overhead when the rider stopped to refuel.
C37. The rider stopped to refuel at a gas station.
C38. The rider stopped voluntarily for deputies on the highway shoulder.
C39. A passenger was riding on the back of the motorcycle.
C40. The driver was stopped for driving 120 mph on I-95.
C41. The driver was going more than 50 mph over the speed limit.
C42. The driver was arrested.
C43. The deputy let the driver go with a warning.
C44. The driver's dog jumped out of the car and ran across the highway.
C45. Deputies spotted a gold Chrysler minivan parked over the fuel port at a Racetrac gas station.
C46. The van then parked at a nearby Waffle House, where the driver ran from responding deputies.
C47. The driver was taken into custody after a short foot chase.
C48. The minivan was carrying a large auxiliary fuel tank.
C49. A hole was cut through the floorboard of the minivan.
C50. The chassis was sitting on wooden 2x4 blocks strapped to the axle using metal retention straps.
C51. Gas cans and a hose were found in the back of the second minivan.
C52. The minivan driver gave up at the gas pump without running.
C53. Deputies found a stolen motorcycle inside the minivan.
C54. The Nissan sedan came to a stop after striking a parked vehicle.
C55. The driver and a passenger took off running while a female passenger stayed behind.
C56. The Air One crew spotted two suspects hiding in the water.
C57. FWC responded with an airboat to bring both suspects back to dry land.
C58. A firearm with an extended magazine was recovered from the Nissan.
C59. A .22 Uzi pistol was found inside a backpack that was discarded at the scene.
C60. Both suspects swam to shore on their own and walked up to the deputies.
C61. The suspects threw a bag of cash into the water.
C62. A rip current pulled the swimmer about 100 yards out in the ocean.
C63. The swimmer was unresponsive with no pulse when lifeguards brought him in.
C64. The swimmer regained a pulse.
C65. The swimmer made a full recovery.
C66. The swimmer walked out of the water on his own.
C67. A dog on the beach barked and alerted the lifeguards.
C68. A boat was spinning in circles on the lake.
C69. Responding units spotted a single unresponsive occupant on the boat.
C70. The Marine Unit crew moved in close enough for a rescuer to jump on board.
C71. The rescuer stopped the boat.
C72. The patient was taken to shore for further treatment.
C73. Two people were on the boat, waving for help.
C74. The boat had run aground on a sandbar before deputies arrived.
